reuse.why: Fintegra reuses shared linking, persistence, bank lookup and download helpers, but takeover repeats the existing unlink operation's local cleanup.

duplication.why: The extraction removes substantial provider duplication, but local unlink cleanup is copied and sync/notification orchestration remains repeated across three linking implementations.

placement.why: Provider transport, models and account orchestration follow existing layers, although a refusal wrapper now also owns unlink mutations.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on linking policies and Fintegra support, including the client registry adjustments required by the expanded provider type.

maintainability.why: Shared provider workflows improve ownership, but duplicated unlink state and a mutation-bearing helper named refuseIfAlreadyLinked obscure lifecycle responsibilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts: refuseIfAlreadyLinked duplicates unlinkAccount's local field reset instead of extracting cleanup shared by ordinary unlink and takeover.

disguised_duplication.where: Remaining unlink cleanup and sync/notification sequences are direct duplication rather than renamed or reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: In app.ts, replaceExistingLink adds a takeover branch to refuseIfAlreadyLinked that performs mutations and bypasses shared ownership of unlinkAccount's local cleanup.
